```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)

# 1. LOAD PREPROCESSED DATA
data <- read_csv("../data/final_preprocessed_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ======================================================================
# STEP A: GLOBAL RANK DEFICIENCY (Perfect Redundancy)
# ======================================================================
cat("\n--- [1] GLOBAL RANK DEFICIENCY CHECK ---\n")
global_fit <- lm(Thermostat_Temperature ~ ., data = data %>% select(-DateTime))
global_alias <- alias(global_fit)

if(!is.null(global_alias$Complete)) {
  cat("!!! WARNING: Perfect Global Redundancy Found !!!\n")
  print(rownames(global_alias$Complete))
} else {
  cat("Success: No perfect global linear dependencies.\n")
}

# ======================================================================
# STEP B: TARGET CORRELATION (Weak Predictor Check)
# ======================================================================
cat("\n--- [2] WEAK PREDICTOR CHECK (Cor with Target) ---\n")
cor_matrix <- data %>%
  select(-DateTime) %>%
  cor() %>%
  as.data.frame()

target_cor <- cor_matrix %>%
  select(Thermostat_Temperature) %>%
  rename(Correlation = Thermostat_Temperature) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Correlation)))

# Threshold 0.02: Variables below this add almost no predictive value
weak_features <- target_cor %>% 
  filter(abs(Correlation) < 0.02)

if(nrow(weak_features) > 0) {
  cat("The following variables have < 0.02 correlation with Thermostat_Temperature:\n")
  print(weak_features)
} else {
  cat("All variables show a baseline correlation > 0.02.\n")
}

# ======================================================================
# STEP C: SEASONAL RANK KILLERS (The "100% Deficiency" Cause)
# ======================================================================
cat("\n--- [3] SEASONAL RANK KILLER CHECK ---\n")

seasonal_blocks <- list(
  Winter = list(start = as.Date("2017-01-01"), end = as.Date("2017-03-19")),
  Spring = list(start = as.Date("2017-03-20"), end = as.Date("2017-06-20")),
  Summer = list(start = as.Date("2017-06-21"), end = as.Date("2017-08-24")),
  Winter_Spring_Hybrid = list(start = as.Date("2017-02-04"), end = as.Date("2017-05-04")),
  Spring_Summer_Hybrid = list(start = as.Date("2017-05-07"), end = as.Date("2017-08-04"))
)

all_dropped_vars <- c()

for (period in names(seasonal_blocks)) {
  sub_data <- data %>%
    filter(DateTime >= seasonal_blocks[[period]]$start & 
           DateTime <= seasonal_blocks[[period]]$end) %>%
    select(-DateTime)
  
  # Diagnostic Fit
  fit <- lm(Thermostat_Temperature ~ ., data = sub_data)
  dropped <- names(coef(fit))[is.na(coef(fit))]
  all_dropped_vars <- c(all_dropped_vars, dropped)
}

# Frequency table: How many seasons does each variable break the model?
drop_report <- as.data.frame(table(all_dropped_vars)) %>% 
  rename(Variable = all_dropped_vars, Seasons_Dropped = Freq) %>%
  arrange(desc(Seasons_Dropped))

if(nrow(drop_report) > 0) {
  cat("Variables dropped most frequently across seasons:\n")
  print(drop_report)
} else {
  cat("Success: No seasonal rank deficiency detected.\n")
}
```
